usage: llm-modelbench campaign clean [-h] [--all] [--apply | --dry-run]
                                     [campaign_id]

positional arguments:
  campaign_id

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --all        process all eligible campaigns and report unsafe skips
  --apply      remove only listed disposable campaign dumps
  --dry-run    preview only (default)
